name: caldav-to-ics
description: Merge your calendars (iCal links and CalDAV) into one link to share, full or busy-only. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: npm run build:css && wrangler deploy && npm run db:migrate

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts calendar links and passwords stored in the database. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32` and never change it afterwards.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address of sign-in emails, on a domain with Cloudflare Email Sending enabled, e.g. `accesso@example.com`.

REFRESH_MINUTES.description: How often calendars are read again, in minutes.
